methodologyNotes: The roster covers 10 high-search ergonomic office chair models spanning premium (Herman Miller, Steelcase), mid-range (Branch, Sihoo, Flexispot, HON, X-Chair), and value-focused (Autonomous) tiers. Sources consulted include manufacturer product pages (hermanmiller.com, store.hermanmiller.com, steelcase.com, store.steelcase.com, autonomous.ai, sihoooffice.com, branchfurniture.com, flexispot.com, xchair.com, hon.com), authorized retailer listings (officechairsusa.com, btod.com), and editorial reviews (SeatedLab, thetechreviewer, Tom's Guide, Techlicious). priceUsd reflects the published US price for the configuration that matches the listed specs (whole dollars). Where a manufacturer sells primarily at a standing promotional price, that price is used and noted. boolean spec values are true when the feature is present and user-adjustable, false when absent or passive-only; null denotes a genuinely unverified value rather than a guess. Re-verified adversarially on 2026-06-15; several draft prices and specs were corrected against primary sources.

products.name: Aeron Chair
products.priceNote: Config matching listed specs (Size B, graphite, PostureFit SL adjustable lumbar, fully adjustable 4D arms, carpet casters) ~$1,750 per Herman Miller / btod 2026; base config starts ~$1,521
products.provenance: CORRECTED price 2150->1750. The store.hermanmiller.com configurator shows $2,150 only for the maxed 'all options' build; base config starts ~$1,520.99 and the configuration matching the listed specs (4D fully adjustable arms + PostureFit SL adjustable lumbar, Size B, graphite, carpet casters) is ~$1,750 per btod 2026. 12-year 3-shift warranty and 8Z Pellicle mesh back/seat confirmed on official specs page. CORRECTED provenance: Size C is rated 350 lb (not 400); btod 2026 rates Size B and C both at 350 lb, seatedlab rates A/B 300 and C 350; max_weight_lb retained at 350 as the most-cited figure for the standard Size B. Remastered 2016 but slug retains original 1994 launch year.

products.name: Embody Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP, base config with fabric upholstery

specs.seat_material: Pixelated Support (textile pixel matrix over springs and structural frame)

products.provenance: VERIFIED unchanged. Price $2,090, 300 lb weight capacity, and 12-year warranty all confirmed directly on the store.hermanmiller.com product page on 2026-06-15. Embody uses BackFit auto-adapting alignment plus Pixelated Support rather than a separate user-adjustable lumbar pad; adjustable_lumbar=false. Pixelated Support back/seat matrix categorized as foam. Released 2008.

products.name: Leap Chair V2
products.priceNote: Current Steelcase Store MSRP base config; headrest and premium casters cost extra
products.provenance: CORRECTED price 998->1299. $998 was an outdated figure (still cached on the cited review); current 2026 Steelcase Store base MSRP is $1,299, confirmed across multiple 2026 retailer/aggregator sources. 400 lb capacity and 12-year Steelcase Limited Lifetime (multi-shift, 24/7) warranty confirmed on steelcase.com. Back is LiveBack under fabric upholstery (not mesh). 4D arms and adjustable lumbar standard. V2 released 2006.

products.name: Gesture Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP starting price; standard config ships with passive Core Equalizer lumbar, no headrest
products.provenance: Starting price $1,499 confirmed by btod 2026 and Steelcase sources. CORRECTED adjustable_lumbar true->false: standard Gesture ships with passive 'Core Equalizer' lumbar; user-adjustable lumbar is an optional paid upgrade, so per the spec definition (true only when present and user-adjustable) this is false in base config. CORRECTED armrests '360-degree (5D)' -> '360-degree': Steelcase's official term is 360-degree arms; btod characterizes them as 4-way (height, depth, width, pivot); the non-standard '5D' label was dropped. 400 lb capacity and 12-year/Limited Lifetime warranty confirmed. 3D LiveBack fabric back. Launched NeoCon 2013.

products.name: Branch Ergonomic Chair
products.provenance: VERIFIED. Price $359, 3D removable armrests, double-layer mesh back, and height-adjustable removable lumbar confirmed on OfficeChairsUSA. 7-year warranty confirmed on Branch's own warranty page (covers both standard Ergonomic Chair and Pro), OfficeChairsUSA, and Tom's Guide. max_weight_lb 275 per OfficeChairsUSA and SeatedLab; note Tom's Guide review states 300 lb, so a 275-300 range exists across sources; 275 retained as the figure on the cited source. Launch year not in public sources; null.

products.name: ErgoChair Pro
products.priceNote: Standing promotional price on autonomous.ai ($100 off $499 list)
products.provenance: VERIFIED. Price $399 (marked down from $499) confirmed directly on the autonomous.ai product page on 2026-06-15. 300 lb capacity confirmed on product page (some third-party listings cite 330 lb for newer stock; 300 retained per the official page). Breathable woven mesh back; seat is polyester over molded foam. 3D armrests (height/depth/angle) confirmed across Autonomous sources. Autonomous advertises a 'lifetime' warranty but the numeric standard-warranty term varies by purchase date (a 2-year term applied to recent purchases); left null to avoid a guess.

products.name: Doro C300
products.priceNote: Current sihoooffice.com price ~$269.99 (regular list $559.99); ~$299.99 on Amazon
products.provenance: CORRECTED max_weight_lb 300->330 and warranty_years 5->3, both confirmed on the official sihoooffice.com and sihoo.com C300 spec pages (and consistent across C300 variants). Price updated 280->270 to the current published sihoooffice.com price of $269.99. Mesh back and synchronizing mesh seat, Domino Dynamic self-adjusting lumbar, and 4D coordinated armrests confirmed on the official product page. CORRECTED corroboration link to a working Tom's Guide C300 review (prior Tech Advisor URL was a 'Pro V2' variant article). Exact release year not found; null.

products.name: Ignition 2.0 Task Chair
products.priceNote: Base mid-back mesh with adjustable arms ~$486 (OfficeChairsUSA); all-adjustable arm option adds ~$98
products.provenance: VERIFIED. Release March 14, 2017 confirmed on HON press release. Ilira-stretch 4-way mesh back, high-density foam seat with waterfall edge, height-adjustable lumbar, and advanced synchro-tilt with tilt lock confirmed. 2D (height + width) arms confirmed. 300 lb capacity confirmed on OfficeChairsUSA. Base mid-back price ~$486 confirmed on OfficeChairsUSA (CHANGED corroboration to the precise mid-back product page). HON offers a Full Lifetime Warranty (frame) with 12-year coverage on seating mechanisms; numeric standard term ambiguous, left null.

products.name: C7 Ergonomic Chair
products.priceNote: Standing promotional price ~$349 for standard all-mesh C7; price varies frequently
products.provenance: VERIFIED. Standard all-black mesh C7 priced ~$349 (matching draft's $350); 10-year warranty, 300 lb capacity, 3D armrests (height/forward-back/swivel), mesh back with mesh-or-foam seat, and dynamic self-adapting lumbar all confirmed across Techlicious and Flexispot C7-family sources. Official source URL is live (returns content; a direct-fetch 403 was bot-blocking, not a dead link). Exact launch year not confirmed; null.
